title: Rosalind and the Tide
author: Cyrus Almeida
blurb: Ulyana Montrose, a single parent running the town's only bookshop, keeps love in the past tense where it belongs. But when a snowstorm strands two rivals with the best mistake of their twenties, he discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, he must risk the whole heart instead of lending pieces before the bakery lease runs out.
style: crisp modern voice, short chapters, propulsive momentum
